body:
CANONICAL, continued: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents (Engram::Fable, 2026-11-03 06:50Z). termal-host-workarounds is at its size limit (rev 97); read both. Each line names the item whose fix retires it.

!! NEVER RERUN ON "UNKNOWN" (P1 TermAl w-96480bbbe221, inverse of w-881c69c0ccdb): TermAl can close a check as Unknown at turn end while its launcher run is STILL RUNNING, and can show a finished check as running.
- Read the launcher's results.json in .git/worktrees/<root>/review-runs/<run-id>/.
- A live executor pid with a fresh heartbeat means running; a terminal state is the result.
- Never rerun, or ask for a new slot, on a TermAl status alone.

- STALE WORK REVISION (TermAl w-c43760ef6a60): TermAl's run registration carries the CLAIM-TIME work_revision. A revise after claiming makes Engram refuse the verification record: verification_record_refused, field work_revision, "work changed since registration" (registered_verification.rs:136). TermAl drops the reason (w-c6ad7b63270d). Until it's fixed, avoid revising a held item before its credited run. The pass stays evidence, but not credit.
- SOURCE ROOT "UNCONFIRMED" recurs after a re-name (TermAl w-426dcbda4467). It never blocks actions. A session that waits for "next turn" needs a continuation message to proceed.
- REMOTE RUNNERS AFTER A QUARANTINE OR RESTART:
  - ENDs may be delayed by 409 "federation link changed" or 503, then re-delivered with the same key (w-c03ce2f854e8); don't rerun.
  - A runner may ADMIT requests queued before the quarantine (w-4226eb67e0f9), so withdraw stale requests explicitly.
  - Relay mail to remote runners often shows durableButNotWoken; they act on their next turn.
- LAUNCHER STOP is Windows-only. On macOS and Linux a detached run can't be stopped (Engram w-efec5adad667). Never kill runner processes by hand: let the run end, then clean up only that run.
- STALE STOP AT A RUNNER: DL560 session-4 (Claude) held jobs under the old 2026-11-02 00:23Z STOP until Fable confirmed the resume (relay #70/#71, 06:28Z). If a runner cites a stale STOP, the coordinator answers it directly with Greg's later words and their sources.
- A git bundle of the exact commit, mailed to a runner, needs no test ref (rules-remote-test-runs-2026-10-31 §2).
